__broaden__.αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’
__broaden__.βαῖνε: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαινε); here tmesis μετέβαινε ’was following’ · also without tmesis: ’went’ (ἀμφ’ ἑνὶ δούρατι βαῖνε ’went astride one timber’)
__broaden__.γένηται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’shall come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg. in a direct question of doubt/deliberation, no ἄν/κε: τί … γένηται; ’what is to happen?’
__broaden__.δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; masc. acc. sg. (δεινὸν χόλον ’dread anger’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (κῦμα): ’dread’; can also be taken adverbially
__broaden__.διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’
__broaden__.δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κλυτὰ δώματ’ ἔασιν ’his famous halls are’
__broaden__.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
__broaden__.εἵματα: εἷμα — garment, clothing; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: εἵματα γάρ ῥ’ ἐβάρυνε ’for the clothes weighed him down’
__broaden__.κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ · also plain acc. sg., direct object of a verb: κινήσας κάρη ’shaking his head’
__broaden__.κύματ: κῦμα — wave; neut. nom. pl., elided (κύματ’ = κύματα): ‘waves’ · also neut. acc. pl., direct object: πρὸ δὲ κύματ’ ἔαξεν ’broke the waves ahead of him’
__broaden__.κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
__broaden__.μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
__broaden__.νέων: νέος — young; masc. gen. pl. · also a different word, νέω ’swim’: pres. part. masc. nom. sg., ’swimming’
__broaden__.πάσας: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. pl., substantival: ’all of them’ (the seals) · also fem. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a noun: πάσας … ἀέλλας ’all the blasts’
__broaden__.πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’
__broaden__.σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
__broaden__.τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’
__broaden__.τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’
__broaden__.φέρεσθαι: φέρω — carry; mid. pres. inf.: ’to carry off for oneself’ · also pass. inf., ’to be carried’ (by the wind): Βορέῃ προβάλεσκε φέρεσθαι ’would toss it to the North Wind to be carried’
__broaden__.ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, among; prep. + dat.: ’along, among’ · also + acc., ’along, across, over’ (motion): ἂμ πεδίον ’over the plain’, ἂμ πέλαγος ’over the open sea’
__broaden__.ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλο): ’another thing’ · also neut. nom./acc. pl. ἄλλα, elided, genuinely ambiguous with the sg. reading: ἄλλ’ ἐνόησεν ’devised other things’ or ’another thing’
__broaden__.ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
__broaden__.ὃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. nom./acc. sg., referring to a person: ’that he...’ · also masc. nom. sg. relative, ’who’, used in address with a 2nd person verb (ὃ χθιζὸς θεὸς ἤλυθες ’you who came yesterday as a god’) · also pron. ’he’, masc. nom. sg. (ἧος ὃ … μιγείη)
__broaden__.ὅτι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅ τι written ὅτι, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also conj. ’that, because’ (ὅτι τοι κακὰ πολλὰ φυτεύει)
__broaden__.ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο)
